# Spark Responses API Transport Fixtures

Replies in the transport envelope `{status, headers, json}` used by `rulecam.clients.transport`.

- `uc1_photo_reply.json`: UC1 photo analysis response extracting handwashing compliance.
- `uc1_pdf_reply.json`: UC1 PDF regulatory analysis extracting cold-holding temperature.
- `walkthrough_reply.json`: Video walk-through analysis extracting functional areas and hazards.
- `voice_analysis_reply.json`: Multi-speaker diarized audio transcript analysis.
